Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability. The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France , and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries. This position is based in Rennes, France. By joining our Engineering team, you won't just be a tester — you'll be at the heart of quality for complex AI systems , working hand in hand with our research team . That's rare. That's exciting. And that's what we offer. As a Senior QA Engineer , you will play a key role in the reliability and robustness of our AI/ML-based identity verification services. You will work day-to-day alongside our data scientists, researchers, and software engineers to design test strategies that match the complexity of our systems. This role is also central to our delivery chain: you will be a key player in our CI/CD pipeline , ensuring every release is production-ready. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain robust automated tests in Python Debug complex components related to AI/ML models and distributed architectures Own and improve our CI/CD pipeline (GitLab CI): test integration, deployment management, and continuous improvement Work closely with the R&D team to anticipate quality risks from the design stage Identify, document, and track bugs throughout their full lifecycle Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to high-quality releases Share best practices and raise the QA bar across teams Preferred Experience 3+ years of experience in QA and test automation on complex systems Strong hands-on skills in Python for automation (pytest, Locust, etc.) Experience working with AI/ML systems (model testing, data pipeline validation, etc.) Solid expertise in CI/CD : building, maintaining, and improving pipelines (GitLab CI or equivalent) Experience in API testing (Postman, REST Assured, or similar) Ability to dive deep into complex code to find the root cause of a bug — you don't wait to be guided, you dig in Autonomous, analytical mindset with a taste for technically demanding environments Fluent English and French (written and spoken) What you get : A privileged collaboration with a world-class research team A stimulating technical environment: AI, image processing, anti-fraud Real impact on products used at a European scale An engineering culture that values autonomy and skills development Perks & Benefits Health & Wellbeing: Use your full access to the mental health platform nilo , including 1on1 sessions. We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy , our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited content/course consumption incl. certification. We make your remote work comfy: we provide support on equipment and offer flexible working hours. We value collaboration & love to come together: regular onsite gatherings, internal initiatives and summer parties to connect outsi

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: Wir rekrutieren einen Software Test Engineer (m/w/d) für ein neu formiertes Team rund um ein Dynamics 365 Projekt. Das Testing wird von Grund auf neu aufgebaut, du bist also massgeblich an der Definition des Vorgehens beteiligt. Du testest im Sprint mit und verantwortest gleichzeitig die Teststrategie, das Testkonzept und die Testplanung. Du koordinierst die UAT mit dem Fachbereich und bringst Qualitätsstandards in ein Team, das seine Testing-Reife gerade aufbaut. Der Fokus liegt überwiegend auf manuellem Testing, mit der Möglichkeit, später in die Automatisierung hineinzuwachsen. Must-have Anforderungen Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Software-Testing in agilen Umgebungen, sicher im Testfalldesign und in der Erstellung von Testkonzepten Erfahrung mit Azure DevOps (Boards, Test Plans) oder Jira Xray Erfahrung im Testing konfigurierter Business-Plattformen, idealerweise Dynamics 365 (CE/CRM) oder Power Platform Sehr gutes Deutsch und fliessendes Englisch Nice-to-have Anforderungen ISTQB Zertifizierung Kenntnisse in Power Platform oder Azure Das erwartet dich Flexibler Homeoffice-Anteil, du entscheidest frei, ob du von zu Hause oder im Büro arbeitest Flache Hierarchien Grosszügige Weiterbildungsförderung Halbtax, Gesundheitsangebote, gemeinsame Anlässe Interessiert an weiteren Informationen?
